name: Past Paper
statement: $\Delta ABC$ is a triangle. $P, Q$ and $R$ are points on $BC, CA$ and $AB$ respectively such that $AP, BQ, CR$ are concurrent and meet at a point $O$. If $\dfrac{AO}{OP} + \dfrac{BQ}{OQ} + \dfrac{CO}{OR} = 10$, find the value of $(\dfrac{AO}{OP})(\dfrac{BQ}{OQ})(\dfrac{CO}{OR})$.
